title: Conditional indemnity offsets and fast-track contract safelist for strategic accounts
creator: Lina Ortega
description: Define and implement a product-backed workflow that allows Sales to request and obtain a fast-track contract decision path (safelist) for strategic accounts where conditional indemnity offsets or liability caps can be applied in exchange for pricing/commitment concessions. This ticket scopes the PM requirements, acceptance criteria, and handoff to Legal and Engineering for MVP: a gated form + decision matrix that surfaces recommended counterparty tiers, pricing impact, and required legal evidence to approve an accelerated MSA/DPA signoff.
background: Problem: Large customers with unique liability asks (e.g., limited indemnity, data residency clauses) cause multi-week negotiation cycles and blockers to Dedicated/Private deals. Sales needs a predictable fast-path for low-to-medium risk asks where commercial concessions can offset legal risk.

Goal: Reduce enterprise contract cycle time for qualifying strategic accounts from ~21 days to <=7 days for requests that meet risk/alignment thresholds; surface pricing impact to Sales and automate routing to Legal or Auto-Approve where appropriate.
Related: complements the contract-onramp and concession-simulator initiatives but focuses on creating a defensible, repeatable safelist decision flow tied to pricing tradeoffs.
Non-goals: This ticket does not change base MSA/DPA language nor implement full automated redlining; it's focused on decision tooling and routing for well-scoped exceptions.
acceptance_criteria: A gated Sales request form is available in the Contract Intake UI capturing counterparty size, industry, required clauses (indemnity/liability/residency), desired cap, and proposed commercial concession (term/commitment/price adjustment).

A decision matrix (visible to Sales and Legal) maps request attributes to recommended outcomes: Auto-Approve, Legal-Review-Expedite, or Standard-Track, with a clear rationale and pricing impact estimate.
Pricing impact estimator shows delta in ARR and unit economics (approx.) that can be accepted by Sales to trigger Auto-Approve when thresholds are met.

Auto-Approve path: for low-risk profiles (predefined industry whitelist, < $X ARR, standard auditors, commitment >= Y months) the system can issue an accelerate token to Sales and create a templated addendum for signatures without full Legal redline.
Audit trail created for every request: captured in contract-intake logs with links to submitted evidence (SOC reports, regional attestations) and final disposition.
Legal playbook pages linked from the UI for each recommended action are populated (short checklist for reviewers when expedite is chosen).
Metrics collection: ticket emits events for time-to-decision, disposition breakdown (auto/expedite/standard), and pricing delta; dashboards show the new flow performance after launch.
Legal approval required for the decision matrix thresholds and safelist before launch (explicit signoff captured in ticket).
tasks: PM: finalize intake form fields and decision thresholds with Legal and Sales (deliver PRD)
Design: mockup intake UI and decision matrix views for Sales and Legal screens
Eng: implement intake API endpoint, persistence, and basic UI components in Contract Intake (backend + frontend)
Legal: define risk tiers, safelist criteria, required evidence items, and approval SLA for expedited reviews
Data: create pricing impact model and agreed thresholds for auto-approve vs expedite
SRE/Infra: ensure logs and audit events are captured and retained per compliance requirements
Release: coordinate rollout plan with Sales ops and AMs, create training doc and 1-pager
